video.title: AI欧腐《我的修理工老公竟是黑帮老大/My Repairman Husband Is the Mafia Boss》
video.desc:
Humiliated at his wedding and forced to marry a filthy vagrant, Silas begs a mysterious repairman to save him. He has no idea Rex is the ruthless mafia godfather who rules the underworld. When Silas's mother is poisoned and his enemies strike again, Rex drops the disguise—and crushes everyone who hurt the man he loves.
Silas在婚礼上受尽羞辱，还被迫嫁给一个邋遢落魄的流浪汉。绝望之际，他向一位神秘的修理工求救。
他并不知道，那个名叫Rex的男人，其实是掌控地下世界、冷酷无情的黑帮教父。
当Silas的母亲遭人下毒，敌人再次出手时，Rex终于不再伪装。他褪去“修理工”的身份，露出真正的獠牙，将所有伤害他所爱之人的人一一碾碎。
